gloss: to get caught up in; to be involved in; to be dragged into

definitions.gloss: to get caught up in; to be involved in; to be dragged into
definitions.explanation: Describes being involuntarily drawn into a situation, conflict, or incident. The passive form of {巻|ま}き{込|こ}む (to involve, to drag in), emphasizing the lack of choice on the subject's part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I got caught up in an accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧けんか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれてしまった。
examples.english: I got dragged into my friend's quarrel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無関係|むかんけい}→無関係：14831_mukankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Uninvolved civilians must never be caught up in a conflict.

notes:
The passive form of ⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ (to involve, to drag in, to engulf). While ⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ focuses on the agent doing the involving, {巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる emphasizes the victim's perspective — being pulled into something against one's will.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in an incident
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to be involved in an accident
- ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get dragged into a dispute
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get mixed up in a crime
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in trouble

USAGE:
Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the situation one is dragged into. Carries a strong implication that the involvement was involuntary and usually unwelcome.

ACTIVE FORM:
⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ means "to involve" or "to drag in" from the agent's perspective:
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to involve those around you
- ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧な: don't drag others into this
